faq_heading: Westridge condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Westridge. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Westridge, Burnaby: 6 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 17% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 19 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Westridge was 1 in June and 6 in October, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall, and 2 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.5% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Westridge?
Westridge also had 10 houses listed and 1 sold in October, against 6 condos and townhomes listed. The Westridge houses page has those figures.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Westridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 condos and townhomes listed in Westridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Westridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Westridge had a sales ratio of 17% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Westridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 2 condos and townhomes sold in Westridge over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
